title: Apple’s iPhone Passcode Problem: Thieves Can Ruin Your Entire Digital Life in Minutes | WSJ
summary: A WSJ investigation by Joanna Stern into iPhone thieves who watch victims enter their passcode, then use it to lock them out of Apple accounts and drain bank and payment apps. It explains how the thefts work and how to protect yourself.
why: HN cites it as evidence that knowing an iPhone passcode is enough to take over an Apple account.

quote.text: You can change the password on someone’s Apple account with only the passcode.
